| The seven default shelves are the seven default shelves (93) | the seven default shelves are there, in order, Favourites first (278) |
| A shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (100) | a shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (285) |

| A book opens on its oldest note (121) | a book opens on its oldest note, and the top bar says which end (363) |

| Undated is a book, not a guess (146) | an undated note lands in Undated, not in a guessed year (311) |
